evidence.computation: Exact ordinary monthly-deposit accumulation and periodic compound growth, with checked money rounding.
assumptions: Deposits occur at the end of each month. The term contains a whole number of months.
Annual rates are nominal fractions; compounding frequency is explicit or uses the documented default.
Two-phase growth, when supported, has no intervening deposits or withdrawals.
untrusted: English recognition and decimal-to-request conversion; mathematical proof does not establish that the sentence was read correctly.

evidence.computation: Apply discounts in sequence, tax the explicitly selected original or discounted price, and answer final price, tax amount, or savings against full price including tax.
assumptions: Each discount is from 0% to 100%; the price and tax rate are nonnegative.
Tax applies after discounts unless the original-price tax base is explicitly requested; savings compares the paid total with full price including tax.
untrusted: English recognition, classification of each percentage, and numeric parsing.
